issues.title: Missing Template Content
issues.why: The overview lists files 04, 05, and 06 as templates for CLI, App, and Non-CLI modules, but the actual content of these templates is not provided in the context, leaving a mediocre AI to guess the boilerplate.
issues.fix: Provide the markdown content for files 04-06 in the context.

issues.title: Linter Script Logic Gaps
issues.why: AC-SAG-30 explicitly states that linter logic is anchored to spec/27 and not restated here. While this is a valid 'walker-pin', a mediocre AI cannot verify if its implementation of a new spec will actually pass those external scripts without seeing their logic.
issues.fix: Include the GWT criteria for the 6 mandatory linter scripts from spec/27 in the context.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'Production-Ready' Thresholds
issues.why: The AI Confidence scoring table uses qualitative terms like 'Minor gaps' or 'Significant gaps'. While AC-SAG-16 adds quantitative checks, it doesn't define the exact line between 'High' and 'Production-Ready' for the percentage-based scoring mentioned in the text.
issues.fix: Add a mapping table between the 0-100% score and the Tier icons (e.g., 90-100 = Production-Ready).
